hardware.variant: One observed 512 MiB RAM and 32 MiB QSPI Nano variant

inputs.name: Native USB and RX streaming kernel sources
Native USB IIO RX service, default 16 blocks

scenario: RAM-only opt-in USB peripheral boot. Receive at 1090 MHz with 2.4 MSPS requested and 2399999 complex samples/s actual. Independently check received DF17 CRC. Separately pause host refills after 50 complete 32768-sample buffers with 16 native blocks; require explicit overflow on exhaustion and a new clean recovery epoch.
expected: Bounded capture reports no native/software loss. A shorter host pause is absorbed; a longer pause reports unknown loss. Positive STOP and context closure precede fresh recovery. No lost epoch is silently continued or joined.
observed: The main run received 289538048 samples, 134 accepted Mode S messages and 32 independently CRC-valid DF17 messages. All native/software loss reports were zero; SIGINT returned zero and preserved the profile. An actual 81.6826 ms host pause completed 11993088 samples with zero native loss. An actual 253.6564 ms pause returned IIOD -75/EOVERFLOW with discontinuities=1 and loss_unknown=1. STOP, idle acknowledgement and context closure completed; a separate recovery epoch received 11993088 samples with zero native loss.
limits: One unit and bounded runs, not indefinite stability or independent per-sample continuity. No calibrated RF sensitivity, timestamped blind-gap or universal queue-capacity claim.
Host pauses are measured wall-clock intervals after full refills, not physical capture timestamps. No I/O query ran during the pause.
Expected overflow is a passing safety outcome, not a loss-free capture. The faulted epoch was stopped and discarded before separate recovery.
AIS RF reception, GUI operation, CPR position decoding, other board revisions and persistent installation remain unqualified. FIR and no-FIR 1.536 MSPS remain unsupported.

Local GCC16 experimental builds and host instrumentation. Artifact hashes, device-specific FPGA/FDT and the host harness are not a public release or generic reproducible installation recipe; inputs identify public source revisions.
The separate 30-minute USB counter observation measures transport, not RF sample continuity.
